scope: 45 active Unit 5 problem walkthroughs, including linked alternate versions and the two refraction activities. Existing archives and static resource galleries are not replaced.
renderer: Code-native SVG; no generated bitmap assets or runtime network dependencies.

sequences.standard: Observe, predict, animate, hold evidence, explain. Replay and pause. Reduced-motion users get a static reveal.
sequences.refraction: Five material pairs; incident-ray animation, prediction, refracted-ray reveal, automatic next case.
sequences.critical: Glass and water: continuous angular sweep, 90-degree limiting case, five algebra steps, then total internal reflection. Reduced-motion mode advances by button.

standards: One title; all values and instructional text inside the diagram stage; buttons immediately below.
Light backgrounds, dark text, outlined yellow light rays.
Responsive geometry and vertically stacked comparisons on phones; SVG text stays selectable.
Labeled axes and units for quantitative graphs; normal-based angles and geometrically consistent lens rays.
Schematic representations and nonliteral particle sizes explicitly identified.
Screen-reader descriptions include the visible measurements and explanation.

checks: Horizontal overflow, clipped labels and text overlaps
